def max_score(N, a):
    # Split the array into three parts
    left_part = a[:N]
    middle_part = a[N:2*N]
    right_part = a[2*N:]
    
    # Max-heap for the left part to get the largest elements
    max_heap_left = [-x for x in left_part]
    heapq.heapify(max_heap_left)
    
    # Min-heap for the right part to get the smallest elements
    min_heap_right = right_part
    heapq.heapify(min_heap_right)
    
    # Calculate the initial score with all elements from the middle part
    current_score = sum(middle_part)
    
    # Try to maximize the score by replacing elements from the middle part
    # with larger elements from the left part or smaller elements from the right part
    for i in range(N):
        # Try to replace with a larger element from the left part
        if max_heap_left and -max_heap_left[0] > middle_part[i]:
            current_score += (-max_heap_left[0] - middle_part[i])
            heapq.heappop(max_heap_left)
        
        # Try to replace with a smaller element from the right part
        if min_heap_right and min_heap_right[0] < middle_part[i]:
            current_score += (min_heap_right[0] - middle_part[i])
            heapq.heappop(min_heap_right)
    
    return current_score
